builds.name: Reference: Protection specialist
builds.goal: Reference for Renata Glasc: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A protective controller who coordinates attack marks and keeps an ally fighting through Bailout's takedown condition. Her R turns enemy attack strength into disruption. Measure passive marks with an ally consuming them and Bailout takedown timing. Enemy attacks during R depend on real enemy builds; an attack experiment cannot invent allied follow-up. Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry.
builds.summary: Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry.
testPlan: Kit question for Renata Glasc: Measure passive marks with an ally consuming them and Bailout takedown timing. Enemy attacks during R depend on real enemy builds; an attack experiment cannot invent allied follow-up.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Moonstone only with useful eligible heals/shields, then the needed active) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Healing/shield power and timed actives test preserving an allied carry. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Only eligible heals/shields benefit; carrying too many actives can reduce practical value.

The route fails Renata Glasc's stated kit question: Measure passive marks with an ally consuming them and Bailout takedown timing. Enemy attacks during R depend on real enemy builds; an attack experiment cannot invent allied follow-up.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Only eligible heals/shields benefit; carrying too many actives can reduce practical value.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, Moonstone only with useful eligible heals/shields, then the needed active. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Redemption, Mikael's Blessing, Dawncore are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, Berserking enemies for [1.25 / 1.75 / 2.25] seconds, causing them to Attack the nearest unit, prioritizing their allies.

While Berserk, enemies gain [100]% Attack Speed.

Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing [65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage and Slowing surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for [2] seconds. Allies hit gain [50 / 65 / 80 / 95 / 110 + (0.5) × AP] Shield for [3] seconds.

Renata's Attacks mark enemies for [6] seconds and deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage if they were unmarked.

Allied champions' Attacks or Abilities consume the mark, dealing [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.01, perLevel=0.0012, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.0013000000035390258, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage.

Renata may only have one target marked at a time.

Renata infuses an ally champion, granting [(10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.01)] Attack Speed and [(10 / 12.5 / 15 / 17.5 / 20 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.01)] Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to [(10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.02)] Attack Speed and [(10 / 12.5 / 15 / 17.5 / 20 + (0.01) × AP) × (0.02)] Move Speed over [5] seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff.

If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds.

If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to [20]% max Health and stop decaying.

The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once.

Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for [1] second and dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for [0.5] seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.
